name: Pronto Infosystem AI Product Assistant for WooCommerce
author: Gaurav Mittal

sections.description:
Pronto Infosystem AI Product Assistant for WooCommerce helps store administrators create and update WooCommerce product content with AI.

Features include:

  • Generate complete product content.
  • Generate product descriptions.
  • Generate short descriptions.
  • Generate product tags.
  • Generate SEO metadata for supported SEO plugins or native plugin metadata.
  • Translate products when Polylang is installed.
  • Choose between supported AI providers such as OpenAI and Google Gemini.
  • Test the configured AI provider connection from the plugin settings.
  • Use model-specific controls for supported OpenAI reasoning models.

The plugin does not automatically contact an AI provider until the administrator configures a provider and uses an AI feature or the connection test.

AI-generated content should be reviewed by the site administrator before publication.

Requirements

  • WordPress 6.5 or later.
  • PHP 7.4 or later.
  • WooCommerce.
  • An API key for the selected AI provider.
  • Polylang is optional and is required only for the translation feature.

External Services

This plugin connects to third-party AI services only when the site administrator configures and uses the corresponding provider or tests its connection.

OpenAI

When OpenAI is selected, the plugin sends the product information included in the generation prompt and the administrator’s prompt to the OpenAI Responses API. The plugin uses the API response to generate requested product content, SEO metadata, tags or translations.

Service: OpenAI API
Terms: https://openai.com/policies/terms-of-use/
Privacy: https://openai.com/policies/privacy-policy/
API documentation: https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/

Google Gemini

When Google Gemini is selected, the plugin sends the product information included in the generation prompt and the administrator’s prompt to the Google Gemini API. The plugin uses the API response to generate requested product content, SEO metadata, tags or translations.

Service: Google Gemini API
Terms: https://ai.google.dev/terms
Privacy: https://policies.google.com/privacy
API documentation: https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs

No AI provider is contacted merely by installing or activating the plugin.

Privacy

The plugin does not create its own external user account system and does not send analytics or tracking data to the plugin author.

When an administrator uses an AI generation, translation or connection-test feature, information included in the request may be transmitted to the selected third-party AI provider. The exact information depends on the product and action being processed.

Site administrators should review the privacy policy and terms of the selected AI provider and update their site’s privacy documentation as appropriate.

Security

API keys are stored in WordPress options and are used for requests to the provider selected by the site administrator. The plugin uses WordPress nonces and capability checks for its administrative AJAX actions.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate WooCommerce.
  2. Upload the pronto-infosystem-ai-product-assistant-for-woocommerce folder to /wp-content/plugins/, or install the plugin ZIP through WordPress.
  3. Activate the plugin from Plugins > Installed Plugins.
  4. Open Pronto Infosystem AI > Settings in the WordPress admin area.
  5. Select OpenAI or Google Gemini.
  6. Enter the API key for the selected provider.
  7. Select an available model and save the settings.
  8. Open a WooCommerce product and use the Pronto Infosystem AI Product Assistant tools.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require WooCommerce?

Yes. WooCommerce must be installed and active.

Does the plugin include an AI API key?

No. Site administrators provide their own API key for the selected provider.

Which AI providers are supported?

The plugin supports the providers included in the installed version, including OpenAI and Google Gemini.

Does the plugin automatically publish AI-generated content?

The plugin updates the selected WooCommerce product when an AI action is used. Review generated content before publishing the product.

Is Polylang required?

No. Polylang is optional. It is required only when using the product translation feature.

Is temperature available for every OpenAI model?

No. Supported reasoning models use a reasoning-effort setting instead of the temperature control. The settings screen adjusts the available controls according to the selected model.

What happens when I uninstall the plugin?

The uninstall routine removes the plugin’s stored settings and its AI jobs table. Product content that was already written to WooCommerce products is not removed.
sections.changelog:
1.0.4

  • Renamed the plugin to Pronto Infosystem AI Product Assistant for WooCommerce.

1.0.3

  • Updated the text domain to match the WordPress.org assigned plugin slug.
  • Updated the plugin package directory to the assigned WordPress.org slug.

1.0.1

  • Fixed plugin-wide naming collisions by applying a unique internal prefix.
  • Enqueued product editor JavaScript through WordPress APIs instead of inline script output.
  • Improved admin asset localization and product editor integration.

1.0.0

  • Initial public release.
  • AI product content generation.
  • Product description generation.
  • Short description generation.
  • Product tag generation.
  • SEO metadata generation.
  • Product translation support with Polylang.
  • OpenAI and Google Gemini provider support.
  • Model-aware OpenAI reasoning and temperature controls.
